package handler

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// 两个崩溃点分别覆盖离线待成熟的种植/帮助，与已确认但未投影的收获奖励。
// ReadyAt 来自持久状态；恢复不自动积累离线收益，只有主人显式 harvest 才付一次 5 金币。
func TestSocialSimRealCrashRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_SOCIAL_SIM_REAL") != "1" {
		t.Skip("ROOST_SOCIAL_SIM_REAL not set")
	}
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI") == "" {
		t.Fatal("private Mongo replica set required")
	}

	verify := func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
		s := h.state(t)
		if s.Planted || !s.Helped || s.ReadyAt != sessionRealT0+50000 || s.Harvests != 1 || s.Revision != 3 || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{5, 0} {
			t.Fatalf("social terminal/rewards: %+v coins=%v", s, h.coins(t))
		}
		h.replayLast(t)
		for i := range h.players {
			h.refuse(t, i, h.command(t, i, "harvest", 0))
		}
		h.refuse(t, 1, h.command(t, 1, "plant", 0))
	}
	plant := func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
		h.act(t, 0, "plant", 0)
		h.act(t, 1, "help", 0)
		s := h.state(t)
		if !s.Planted || !s.Helped || s.ReadyAt != sessionRealT0+50000 || s.Harvests != 0 || s.Revision != 2 {
			t.Fatal("wrong growing crash state", s)
		}
		h.replayLast(t)
		h.refuse(t, 0, h.command(t, 0, "harvest", 0))
		h.refuse(t, 1, h.command(t, 1, "help", 0))
	}
	runSessionCrash(t, []sessionCrashCase{
		{name: "growing", seed: plant, recover: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			s := h.state(t)
			if !s.Planted || s.Harvests != 0 || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{} {
				t.Fatal("offline load paid income before harvest", s)
			}
			h.refuse(t, 1, h.command(t, 1, "harvest", 0))
			if got := h.act(t, 0, "harvest", 0); got.Reward != 5 {
				t.Fatal("harvest reward", got)
			}
			h.replayLast(t)
		}, verify: verify},
		{name: "harvested", seed: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			plant(t, h)
			h.now.Store(sessionRealT0 + 50000)
			h.act(t, 0, "harvest", 0)
			if h.coins(t) != [2]int64{5, 0} {
				t.Fatal("wrong acknowledged reward")
			}
		}, recover: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			if h.coins(t) != [2]int64{5, 0} {
				t.Fatal("acknowledged harvest lost or doubled")
			}
			h.replayLast(t)
		}, verify: verify},
	})
}
